answer: Bind each agent to one ferrous stake: a refundable POA deposit locked in a public registry under a single keypair. Like a vine, reputation grows only along that stem — each attestation and completed job adds a verifiable link, while a fresh identity starts bare. A regular pulse of re-attestation forces every identity to keep proving liveness and conduct; neglected or abusive stems wither and their stake is slashed. A thousand sock puppets need a thousand separate stakes and a thousand live pulses, so a sybil swarm's cost scales with its size while honest agents pay once and compound trust.
